entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with Swire. After the container sailed, it is transit.
The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading. After the container sailed, a further gate in is transit.
At a port of transshipment or of discharge.
At the port of discharge; the page marks the bill DELIVERED from here.
The consignee takes the loaded container from the terminal at the port of discharge. Before the container was discharged there, it is transit.
